name_en: Grundtvig/Denmark/Folk High School/Education: Folk High Education & Civil Society Construction
description_zh: 尼古拉·弗雷德里克·塞维林·格伦德维 (1783-1872) 丹麦牧师/诗人/历史学家/教育家/民间高等学校/创始人/生活/启蒙/对话/歌唱/丹麦/语言/民族/觉醒/农民/公民/社会/民主/合作社/运动/遗产/格伦德维/丹麦。核心模式：民间高等教育公民社会 — 民间/高等/生活/启蒙/对话/歌唱/农民/公民/合作社/民主/遗产/格伦德维/丹麦。体现 M256 民间高等教育/公民社会 — 以"生活+启蒙+对话+公民"四位一体，在农民/精英/语言/民主四重张力中构建丹麦民间高等教育公民社会范式。
description_en: Nikolai Frederik Severin Grundtvig (1783-1872) Danish pastor/poet/historian/educator/Folk High School/founder/life/enlightenment/dialogue/singing/Danish/language/national/awakening/peasants/citizens/society/democracy/cooperatives/movement/legacy/Grundtvig/Denmark. Core model: Folk High Education Civil Society — folk/high/life/enlightenment/dialogue/singing/peasants/citizens/cooperatives/democracy/legacy/Grundtvig/Denmark. Exemplifies M256 Folk High Education/Civil Society — quaternity of 'life + enlightenment + dialogue + citizenship' building Danish folk high education civil society paradigm amid quadruple tensions of peasants/elites/language/democracy.
reason_zh: 格伦德维非单纯教育家，而是"生活+启蒙+对话+公民"四位一体民族唤醒者。以民间高等学校唤醒农民意识，以丹麦语/歌唱构建民族认同，以合作社运动奠定经济基础。M256 区隔于 M254 诺贝尔慈善(诺贝尔)、M255 瓦伦伯格工业(瓦伦伯格)、M257 曼纳海姆战争(曼纳海姆)，核心在于"生活即教育本体+启蒙即民族唤醒+对话即民主方法+公民即社会主体"的丹麦民间高等教育公民社会范式。
reason_en: Grundtvig not mere educator but 'life + enlightenment + dialogue + citizenship' quaternity national awakener. Folk high schools awakened peasant consciousness, Danish language/singing built national identity, cooperative movement laid economic foundation. M256 distinct from M254 Nobel Philanthropy (Nobel), M255 Wallenberg Industry (Wallenberg), M257 Mannerheim War (Mannerheim), core: 'life as education ontology + enlightenment as national awakening + dialogue as democratic method + citizenship as social subject' Danish folk high education civil society paradigm.
